WITH product_first_sale AS (
    SELECT
        fos.ProductKey,
        min(toStartOfMonth(fos.DateKey)) AS first_sale_month
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
    GROUP BY fos.ProductKey
),
monthly_subcategory_sales AS (
    SELECT
        dps.ProductSubcategoryKey,
        dps.ProductSubcategoryName,
        toStartOfMonth(fos.DateKey) AS sales_month,
        countDistinctIf(fos.ProductKey, pfs.first_sale_month = toStartOfMonth(fos.DateKey)) AS new_product_introductions,
        sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, pfs.first_sale_month < toStartOfMonth(fos.DateKey)) AS existing_product_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
    INNER JOIN product_first_sale AS pfs
        ON fos.ProductKey = pfs.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS dp
        ON fos.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS dps
        ON toInt32(dp.ProductSubcategoryKey) = dps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    GROUP BY
        dps.ProductSubcategoryKey,
        dps.ProductSubcategoryName,
        sales_month
)
SELECT
    ProductSubcategoryKey,
    ProductSubcategoryName,
    count() AS months_analyzed,
    countIf(new_product_introductions > 0) AS months_with_introductions,
    sum(new_product_introductions) AS total_new_product_introductions,
    round(avgIf(existing_product_sales, new_product_introductions > 0), 2) AS avg_existing_product_sales_when_new_products_introduced,
    round(avgIf(existing_product_sales, new_product_introductions = 0), 2) AS avg_existing_product_sales_without_introductions,
    round(
        avgIf(existing_product_sales, new_product_introductions > 0)
        - avgIf(existing_product_sales, new_product_introductions = 0),
        2
    ) AS sales_difference,
    round(
        100.0 * (
            avgIf(existing_product_sales, new_product_introductions > 0)
            - avgIf(existing_product_sales, new_product_introductions = 0)
        ) / nullIf(avgIf(existing_product_sales, new_product_introductions = 0), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_difference,
    round(corr(toFloat64(new_product_introductions), existing_product_sales), 4) AS correlation_between_introductions_and_existing_product_sales
FROM monthly_subcategory_sales
GROUP BY
    ProductSubcategoryKey,
    ProductSubcategoryName
ORDER BY correlation_between_introductions_and_existing_product_sales DESC, ProductSubcategoryName ASC
